digest.en: Tensions are escalating in the Strait of Hormuz as Iran warns that any US interference would be a ceasefire violation. The US and Iran are engaged in talks, with Trump announcing a plan to escort ships through the strait. Gas prices have surged over 30 cents a gallon in response.

articles.title: Any US "Interference" In Hormuz Would Be Ceasefire Violation, Warns Iran
articles.summary: Iran warned the US that interfering in the Strait of Hormuz would breach the ceasefire. A senior Iranian official made the statement on Monday. articles.title: Oil Tanker Hijacking Stokes Fear of Links Between Houthi Rebels and Somali Pirates

articles.title: Gas prices went up more than 30 cents a gallon last week. How high could they go?
